title: Devon's Crucible - Soul Contracts
body:
"Power comes at a price. Sign the pact. Spill the blood. Bind your soul."

Soul Vow is a dark fantasy Minecraft mod that introduces a dangerous new layer of progression through soulbinding contracts, blood-infused mechanics, and the cursed alloy known as Hemosteel.

🧛‍♂️ Note from the Creator
This mod is still in active development. Some systems (like rituals, bosses, or Hemosteel upgrades) are planned for future updates. Feedback is appreciated!

 
🩸 Features
 

🔗 Soulbinding Contracts

Forge pacts between players with magical contracts

Soulbound players gain shared buffs—or consequences

Breaking a vow unleashes curses... or worse

⚙️ Blood Mechanics

Bleed, extract, and manipulate blood

Use blood as fuel for rituals, machines, and enchantments

Create Blood Orbs, Soul Inks, and other alchemical ingredients

🛡️ Hemosteel Gear

Craft armor and weapons from Hemosteel, a living metal that feeds on blood

Items repair themselves with kills or blood offerings

Powers grow stronger as your health weakens—true strength comes from suffering

⚰️ Dark Rituals & Forbidden Magic (WIP)

Upcoming additions include summoning, soul forges, and vampiric progression

🧪 Works Great For:
 

Hardcore SMP servers with betrayal mechanics

Roleplay-heavy servers with angels/demons lore

PvP modes with high stakes and permanent consequences

📜 Mod Requirements & Compatibility
 

Requires Minecraft 1.20.1

Built using MCreator

Compatible with most magic/RPG mods (Blood Magic, Vampirism, etc.)
